semantics.summary: Calculates the inverse of a square matrix and writes the result to another matrix of the same type and dimensions; the documented operand direction is disputed within the source.
side-effects: Writes the inverse matrix to the destination operand.

printed-pages: Chapter 13, printed p. 13-22 command summary; printed p. 13-39 detailed description and example (combined update scan pp. 13-22 and 13-39)
notes: The command summary lists MAT INV a()=b().
The detailed description and worked example say MAT INV b()=a(), with the inverse of a() written to b().
Do not choose an operand direction until an authoritative independent edition or original-interpreter observation resolves the conflict.
The disputed syntax is deliberately retained as two alternatives for review; it is not an implementation contract.
